platform: Ubuntu 24.04.3 under WSL2, GCC 13.3 i686, private Xvfb display with Mesa llvmpipe 25.2.8

build.crossFile:
[binaries]
c = ['gcc', '-m32']
cpp = ['g++', '-m32']
ar = 'ar'
strip = 'strip'
pkg-config = 'pkg-config'

[host_machine]
system = 'linux'
cpu_family = 'x86'
cpu = 'i686'
endian = 'little'

[properties]
needs_exe_wrapper = false
pkg_config_libdir = ['/usr/lib/i386-linux-gnu/pkgconfig', '/usr/share/pkgconfig']

sessions.label: linux-client-retail-v24-pure0-glx

wait 300
renderer_switch
screenshot linux_before
record linux_client_probe
wait 120
screenshot linux_after
wait 3
stoprecord
echo LINUX_INTEROP_COMPLETE
quit

activeStateEvidence: CL_FirstSnapshot prints only after setting cls.state=CA_ACTIVE; each corresponding server also reports ClientBegin: 2.
testHarnessCorrection: The first session completed successfully, but its initial assertion expected the server-only CS_ACTIVE marker in the client log. The actual client CL_FirstSnapshot and server ClientBegin observations establish active state; no engine code was changed.
limits: No Linux audio or physical input/device test in this record.
Software raster rendering only, not hardware ray tracing.
Short bot-backed sessions with a stationary test client; not campaign, long-duration gameplay, or public-server coverage.
safety: No input injection; clients use private Xvfb windows with mouse and joystick disabled.
Only engine screenshot commands; assets are read-only independent copies and homes are under E:/Games/fnTech3-tests.
Local test traffic only; RCON passwords and client GUIDs excluded; no proprietary media committed.
